Whole-exome sequencing of SNPs in athletes; no DNA methylation, histone, chromatin or clock measure was assayed.
Case-control study measuring CDKN2B/NEUROG1 methylation in peripheral blood leukocytes and relating it to gastric cancer susceptibility and modifiable exposures such as smoking and diet.
Twelve-patient descriptive clinico-radiological-molecular case series with no comparison group, despite the self-label of cohort study.
Integrated multi-omics characterisation of 79 tumours with measured DNA methylation, but the abstract never states an analytic design so eligibility under criterion 2 cannot be settled.
Longitudinal paediatric cohort profiling genome-wide DNAm in children exposed in utero to maternal obesity and gestational diabetes, both modifiable exposures.
The paper's contribution is construction of a methylation-based SVM classification model for glioneuronal tumours, i.e. a tool-development study rather than one of the five eligible designs.
In-silico mining of TCGA/GTEx/CGGA databases plus cell-line experiments; no primary study with an eligible design.
Moli-sani cohort participants had global 5mC and 5hmC measured by ELISA and related to dietary glycaemic index and load, a modifiable dietary exposure.
Epigenome-wide DNAm assayed in saliva from 1135 veterans and related to smoking status and nicotine dependence, a modifiable exposure.
Randomised trial of the HDAC inhibitor vorinostat reporting only survival and toxicity outcomes; no epigenetic marker was measured.
Neonatal sepsis risk-calculator agreement study with no epigenetic marker measured at all.
Report of the first two cutaneous cases with a comparison set of eight visceral tumours, i.e. a case report/series.
Cross-sectional study of 4391 older adults with epigenome-wide blood DNAm mediating associations between heavy-metal exposure and ADL disability.
Retrospective cohort of 201 oligodendroglioma patients with EPIC-array methylation profiling related to timing of postoperative radiochemotherapy and to PFS/OS.
Two large prospective cohorts relating plant-based diet indices to colorectal cancer incidence by tumour CpG island methylator phenotype, a directly determined methylation marker.
Chinese-language article (bracketed translated title, Chinese preventive medicine journal); all earlier criteria are satisfied so language is the first applicable exclusion.
Descriptive molecular assessment of 15 paratesticular rhabdomyomas with no comparison group; H3C2 mutation is a genetic, not a measured epigenetic, marker.
Normative Aging Study cohort with 450K DNAm-derived EpiSmokEr smoking phenotypes related to incident airflow limitation and mortality (prognosis).
Retrospective series of 200 ependymomas with H3K27me3 immunohistochemistry (a measured histone modification) analysed against PFS and OS.
Published interview with an investigator; no primary data.
Case-control study directly measuring miR-34b/c promoter DNA methylation by methylation-specific PCR in HPV-negative OSCC and relating it to prognosis, so ncrna_only does not apply.
Cross-sectional study pyrosequencing CDKN2B/CDKN2A methylation in 190 Huichol individuals against occupational pesticide exposure and urinary dialkylphosphates.
450K methylation arrays compared breast-to-brain metastases with normal breast and primary breast tumours and validated candidate loci in serum tfcDNA as prognostic markers.
Biological-age model built from serum brain-gut-axis metabolites, not from an epigenetic clock or any measured epigenetic marker.
Epigenome-wide and targeted DNAm measured longitudinally in rape-exposed women and related to PTSD symptom status, a clinical outcome.
SIRT6 was assayed as a circulating serum protein by ELISA and Western blot, a protein measurement rather than a histone modification or chromatin state.
Longitudinal plasma targeted bisulfite methylation profiling in 65 resected NSCLC patients for detecting molecular residual disease and predicting recurrence.
Prospective study of 30 patients with 11p15 methylation measured by MS-MLPA and bisulfite pyrosequencing and correlated with predicted leg length discrepancy to inform treatment planning.
Mitochondrial DNA copy number and MECP2 genotype were measured; no DNA methylation, histone or chromatin marker was assayed.
Case-control comparison of BRCA1 promoter methylation by pyrosequencing in peripheral blood of Alzheimer's disease patients and controls as a candidate surrogate marker.
Retrospective case series of four ovarian carcinoid tumours.
Methylated THBS1 quantified by MSP in tumour tissue, peritoneal lavage fluid and serum of 92 gastric cancer patients to predict peritoneal dissemination and prognosis.
Phase 2 trial of an HDAC/PI3K inhibitor whose biomarkers were MYC protein expression and protein-activity inference; no epigenetic marker was measured.
Wuhan-Zhuhai cohort with epigenome-wide DNAm mediating the association between urinary PAH metabolites and fasting plasma glucose.
Case-control comparison of RAP1GAP promoter methylation by methylation-specific PCR in 160 thyroid samples, evaluated as a diagnostic and staging biomarker.
Birth cohort of 1313 neonates with cord-blood ARRDC3 methylation linking prenatal PM2.5 exposure to childhood growth trajectories.
Case-control diagnostic-accuracy study in 308 recruited lung cancer patients and 261 matched controls using directly measured plasma methylation for cancer detection.
FKBP5 intron 7 methylation measured by bisulfite sequencing in psychosis patients, siblings and controls in relation to childhood trauma exposure.
Methylation profiling compared mesothelioma with 202 neoplastic and reactive mimics in discovery and independent validation cohorts for diagnostic discrimination.
Retrospective review of 16 cases with no comparison group, i.e. a descriptive case series.
Epigenome-wide nasal DNAm in 503 Project Viva children related to residential PM2.5 exposure, with replication in PIAMA.
Reduced-representation bisulfite sequencing of 18 paired tumour/normal NSCLC tissues with pyrosequencing validation in an independent patient cohort for diagnostic discrimination.

Prospective cohort of about 4500 participants with individual-level VTRNA2-1 blood methylation tested against genotype and adult lifestyle factors including smoking, BMI, alcohol and diet.
Isle of Wight birth cohort with pre-adolescent genome-wide DNAm predicting BMI status transition, replicated in ALSPAC.
Targeted sequencing detected mutations in SWI/SNF chromatin-remodelling genes; no chromatin state, methylation or histone modification was actually measured.
Promoter methylation of Ras isoforms measured by methylation-specific PCR in 87 bladder tumour biopsies and related to stage, grade and diagnostic utility.

Serum methylated RUNX3 measured in 55 pancreatic cancer patients, 12 benign disease and 80 healthy controls with sensitivity and specificity for early detection, read as a case-control diagnostic accuracy study.

Prognostic methylation signature built entirely from TCGA; the instrument treats individual-level cohort re-analysis as eligible but purely in-silico database re-analysis as not_primary, and the abstract does not resolve which applies.
